description: Your tenant on the coordination layer (_TENANT_v1_): id, keys (prefixes), the one next step, what you can build (each product with a sandbox action), and your own traffic over range 1d|7d|30d|90d: REST, MCP, RPC by chain, gateway, errors, demands, settles, pools, grades, credits, spend; plus GRID accrued by your wallet and GPU credit at the gate. Needs your key (api_key, or the X-API-Key header on this server). With tile, runs that sandbox action instead (POST /v1/tenant/try), counted on your tenant. GETs the live /v1/tenant/me.
name: taifoon_tenant
